name: Dual Sign Rank of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: After transposition, the columns indexed by singleton concepts still form an n-by-n signed identity submatrix, so the dual sign rank is at least 3 for $n\geq4$. The dual class has VC dimension one, and the VC-one sign-rank theorem gives the upper bound 3. Therefore the dual sign rank is exactly 3.
